selected_evidence.requirement: Allow node2 -> node3 TCP/5432, reject all other cross-LAN traffic (functional requirement)
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline showed unrestricted access; VyOS forward-filter firewall committed with default-drop, established/related accept, and a specific accept for tcp/5432 lan-a->lan-b; post-config test shows 5432 succeeds, ssh/22 and ICMP time out/drop, with rule hit counters confirming exact match paths.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 7668189d...; reboot issued; exec timed out/reset while down; new boot_id 1d03b17e... confirms restart; post-restart interfaces eth1/eth2 and firewall ruleset intact (config persisted via save), and functional recheck (5432 allow / 22 block) passed.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e65e6bcf...; reboot issued; connection timed out while down; new boot_id 2b8db6ee... confirms restart; post-restart ip route shows persisted cross-LAN static route and functional recheck (5432 allow / 22 block) passed.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, boot identity change, recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8c28f3cd...; reboot issued; connection timed out while down; new boot_id c50d16b1... confirms restart; post-restart firewalld port 5432 and static route persisted; final full-chain recheck from node2 shows 5432 succeeds and 22/ICMP blocked, with VyOS rule counters (rule10=3 pkts allowed, default drop=8 pkts) proving the router firewall was live and enforcing across all three restarts.
